## History

Mr. Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as a newly married young minister, beginning his ministry alongside his wife while still on their honeymoon. Soon after his arrival, he and his wife visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea, where they admired the decorated table and enjoyed pleasant conversation with [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Mr. Allan continued to serve as the local minister while establishing a presence in the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community alongside Mrs. Allan. He remained settled in the village through the following years as the parish life and local school terms progressed.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan is a supportive acquaintance who warmly approves of Anne's choices. The two first connected closely after a disaster at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavored a cake for the minister and his wife with liniment; Mrs. Allan responded by following a devastated [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to her room to comfort and reassure her. Since then, Mrs. Allan has hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a wonderful afternoon tea at the manse, earning Anne's deepest admiration.

- Friend of — supportive acquaintance who approves of Anne's choices  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX.
